name: facade_depth
description: Facade depth (立面纵深) three-part treatment + junction chapter, GEOMETRY ONLY around an existing wall box. 三段式: (1) 基座放脚 — footing ring protrudes 1 past the wall line for base_height layers, top course 收分 as upside-down stairs with backs INWARD (outer corners); optional apron (散水) slab ring one cell further out. (2) 墙身 — string-course ledge rings every string_course_every layers (upside-down stairs, backs OUTWARD, inner corners) + recess panels (壁龛): 1-deep air carve into the principal facade with a sill ledge below each. (3) 檐口封檐 — cornice overhang ring (default 1: 98.9% of GrabCraft samples; 2 = rare deep eave, stepped inner half=top + outer half=bottom) + fascia slab row sealing the eave edge. 交接专章: 墙-地面 = 放脚+散水 (本卡); 墙-屋顶 = 檐口出挑+封檐板 (本卡, 屋顶本身归 gable/hip_roof); 屋顶-烟囱泛水圈 = 调 chimney.py 的 ledge ring, 禁止重复造; 建筑-场地挡土墙/踏步 = terraform_pad/terrace_farm, 本卡只到散水.
when_to_use: Any rectangular building whose elevations read flat — this card adds the Z-axis relief (base/body/cornice) that the 'AI look' lacks. Run AFTER the walls stand: origin = wall footprint north-west corner, y = ground layer, facing = principal facade. Materials here are single trim blocks; the wall body's 材质掺比/做旧 is wall_weathering's job, vertical pier rhythm is pilaster's, window openings are window_trim/arch_window's — do not recreate them via recess_panels.

profiles.medieval_townhouse: base 2 石脚 + 线脚每4层 + 出挑1 + 散水; relief 0.23 (凹凸率中位)
profiles.modern_flat: base 1 + 无线脚 + 净檐口出挑1 + 无散水; relief 0.10
profiles.sakura_shinkabe: base 1 石基 + 木檐口出挑1 + 散水; relief 0.18 (小房档)
profiles.east_asian_formal: 台基 2 + 深檐出挑2 (~1% 变体) + 散水; relief 0.20

origin.notes: 墙体外包盒西北角;y=地面层

facing.notes: 主立面朝向;壁龛只开在主立面;朝向/转角状态全由脚本推导

profile.notes: L3 参数预烘焙;下列参数传 null=继承 profile,显式传值=单参数覆盖

cornice_overhang.notes: 檐口出挑;98.9% 样本=1,2 为深檐变体

recess_panels.notes: 主立面壁龛数(2宽+1间隔);需 height>=base_height+4

relief_budget.notes: 凹凸率预算,仅推导默认壁龛数;校准自层图统计(中位0.23,小房0.18/大房0.28)

apron.notes: 散水半砖环(建筑-场地收边)

trim_stairs.notes: 放脚收分/线脚/檐口/壁龛窗台共用楼梯料

pitfalls: 分工边界:本卡只管 Z 轴几何纵深——材质掺比/渐变/藤蔓归 wall_weathering,竖向壁柱节奏归 pilaster,门窗洞口归 window_trim/arch_window;别拿 recess_panels 仿壁柱,别在本卡输出里掺材质
屋顶-烟囱泛水圈已在 chimney.py(ledge ring),建筑-场地挡土墙/踏步在 terraform_pad/terrace_farm——调用现成卡,重复造必打架
出挑别超过 2:层图统计 98.9% 是 1 格,2 已是深檐变体;想要更深请改屋顶卡的 overhang,不是在檐口叠环
relief_budget 是统计校准的凹凸率预算,不是越大越好:大房上限 0.43,超过即成碎立面;小房 0.18 档别硬塞 3 个壁龛
线脚/檐口环是悬挑件,靠墙体侧向支撑——必须先有墙再跑本卡;验收 support_check 要把墙体文件传给 base 参数
所有 facing/half/shape 由脚本推导(放脚 backs inward=outer corner,线脚/檐口 backs outward=inner corner),禁止手改输出里的方向状态
